# U Win Floortech - AI Fact Sheet
U Win Floortech (https://uwinfloortech.com) is a turnkey sports flooring solution provider based in India. We operate a manufacturer-direct model, supplying and installing 6 certified surface systems without trading middlemen.

## Six Product Lines:
1. PP Interlocking Modular Sports Tiles (Outdoor Hard Courts)
2. EPDM Rubberised Tracks and Play Areas
3. Acrylic Court Coating Systems (ITF Certified)
4. Badminton PVC Vinyl Sports Flooring (Indoor)
5. Badminton Wooden Flooring - Teakwood and Canadian Maple (BWF standard)
6. Sand-Based Artificial Grass (Recreational Turf)
